ruling.recommended_action: Dismiss the fare-refund claim; the fixed RydeX quote was correctly applied and no recoverable item exists. Append a note of the RD-1 breach (unexplained route deviation) to T-2019 for pattern monitoring only; flag the driver's account for Ryde review given two upheld route-deviation disputes in the last 90 days.

segment_findings.reason: GPS trace departs the quoted corridor substantially during the trip (e.g. loop north to ~1.3015/103.8371, hook back east to ~1.2953/103.8318, and the western bulge via ~1.2802/103.8271 and ~1.2872/103.8224), while the quoted route is 10.761 km. No traffic incident (traffic.incidents empty) and only band 4 (free-flow) bands, so no RD-4 exemption; chat is empty, so no RD-3 stop request and no RD-5 consent. Constitutes an unexplained off-route segment under RD-1 and a recordable breach; no monetary refund because RD-2's non-metered branch yields 0.

rejected_claims.reason: RydeX is fixed-price (RD-2 non-metered branch). The 15.17 distance fare corresponds to the same 10.761 km the rider was quoted, and the breakdown contains no ERP/toll, waiting fee or edit-destination fee, so no overcharge exists to refund; the deviation is recorded as an RD-1 breach only.

A self-serving statement that the GPS rerouted him is not a 'reasonable cause' exemption; RD-4 requires a matching LTA traffic incident on the replaced optimal route, and traffic.incidents is empty (only band 4 bands).
